csv_project_name: AE for General Architectural Design Services
csv_scope_of_work: Bannock County seeks statements of qualifications from qualified architectural firms to provide architectural design services for County-approved facility projects during a one-year contract term. Identify projects completed or ongoing that are similar in scope and size to the project under consideration, such as: Designing a new Coroner s Office, Remodeling office space, Design a free-standing building connector skywalk at the Courthouse, Constructing new storage building Roof replacement.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Site Evaluation/Selection, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: AE for General Architectural Design Services
short_description: County seeks architectural design services for various facility projects over one year.
project_scope: One-year on-call architectural design services for county-approved facility projects in Bannock County. Example projects listed include a new Coroner's Office, office space remodeling, a free-standing building connector skywalk at the courthouse, a new storage building, and roof replacement. No sizes, spans, floor areas, or technical parameters are stated.
services: General architectural design services with requested disciplines including architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, cost estimating, site evaluation/selection, environmental engineering/planning/design, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a general architectural services RFQ for miscellaneous county facility projects.
- Scope is broad and mostly building-related without a clearly defined structurally ambitious project.
- Includes structural engineering, but only as one discipline among many.
- Example skywalk could be of some interest, but no span, complexity, or dedicated bridge scope is provided.
- Resembles an on-call/general services contract rather than a specific high-value structural opportunity.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice only lists possible example projects: a new Coroner's Office, office remodeling, a courthouse connector skywalk, a storage building, and roof replacement. No realistic overall construction cost estimate is possible because the contract covers multiple undefined projects over a one-year term.
fee_explanation: No design fee or estimated contract value is stated. As this is an on-call one-year architectural services contract for undefined future projects, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Qualified architectural firms are requested to submit statements of qualifications and identify completed or ongoing projects similar in scope and size to the projects under consideration, such as a new Coroner's Office, office remodeling, a courthouse connector skywalk, a storage building, and roof replacement.
